entry.author: OmbudsmanNZ
entry.summary:
Mere wasn’t getting disability support at school, so she asked the Ombudsman to check things out. Learn more about how the Ombudsman can help you at ombudsman.parliament.nz 
-
This video is part of Keeping Things Fair, a teaching resource on the role of the New Zealand Ombudsman. 
View the resources in English and te reo Māori: https://www.ombudsman.parliament.nz/resources/tuia-kia-orite-keeping-things-fair-fairness-teaching-resources
